useCase: Preliminary screening for AI生成的 content and post-processing 检测
mechanism: Computes per-channel 直方图s (R, G, B, Luminance) and 分析 for gaps, spikes, periodicity, and smoothness metrics. Natural images have characteristic 直方图 shapes that differ from AI生成的 content.
accuracy: 中等 - 70-82%（作为独立方法，与其他信号结合时更高）
name: 直方图分析
algorithm: 多通道直方图分布分析
parameters: Bins: 256, Channels: R/G/B/L, Metrics: kurtosis, skewness, 熵, gap count, periodicity index
description: 分析 color and luminance 直方图 分布s for 统计 异常. AI生成的 images often show unnaturally smooth or periodic 直方图 模式.

references.title: Popescu, A.C. & Farid, H. (2005). Statistical Tools for Digital Forensics. Information Hiding.
McCloskey, S. & Albright, M. (2019). Detecting GAN-generated Imagery using Saturation Cues. IEEE ICIP.

strengths:
• Very fast computation
• Effective preliminary screening tool
• 检测 common AI 直方图 模式
• Works 跨 all image formats
limitations:
• Low standalone 检测 rate
• Post-processing easily alters 直方图s
• Natural images can have unusual 直方图s
• Color-corrected images produce 误报
